title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.
